planner.instructions: Break down the user request into 3-5 clear, independent tasks. Each task must be actionable and assigned to a single team. Prioritize tasks logically. Return only valid JSON.

manager.instructions: Review each task carefully and assign it to the most qualified team member based on their skills and role description. Consider workload balance. Always use the 'assign_task_to_worker' tool.

worker.instructions: Produce complete, high-quality, production-ready output. Do not use placeholders or generic examples. Your output will be reviewed — aim for a score above 7/10.

reviewer.instructions: Evaluate the output objectively. Score from 1-10. Approve if score >= 7. If rejecting, provide specific, actionable revision instructions. Be fair but demanding of quality.
